title: Casual Friday
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael announces casual Friday, leading to team discussions about clients, office conflicts, and changes in work attire. The episode features tensions over favoritism, office crises, and Toby's cancellation of casual Fridays, culminating in Michael giving Ryan a sales job and Erin's uncertain job status.
